description: Implementation of a condition variable class for thread synchronization, supporting different platform versions and clock types.

classes.name: ConditionVariable
classes.description: A class providing thread synchronization primitives using condition variables.

methods.name: ConditionVariable
methods.description: Constructor initializing the condition variable with a mutex, handling platform-specific details.

methods.name: ~ConditionVariable
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up the condition variable resources.

methods.name: Wait
methods.description: Blocks the current thread until the condition variable is signaled.

methods.name: WaitTimed
methods.description: Blocks the current thread until the condition variable is signaled or timeout occurs.

methods.name: Broadcast
methods.description: Wakes all threads waiting on the condition variable.

methods.name: Signal
methods.description: Wakes one thread waiting on the condition variable.
